facts.claim: CRM field code can be read from URL of opened user field in CRM settings
facts.evidence: Official path: CRM > Настройки > Настройки CRM > Настройки форм и отчетов > Пользовательские поля; open field then inspect browser address bar

facts.claim: crm.item.fields returns fields map, key is field name/code; useOriginalUfNames Y yields original UF_CRM names, N/default camelCase
title and upperName separate metadata properties; isRequired/isMultiple/isDynamic separate flags
Numeric definition ID distinct from symbolic FIELD_NAME; symbolic code need not have purely numeric suffix
facts.evidence: Official response shows ID6997 and FIELD_NAME UF_CRM_HELLO_WORLD

facts.claim: Numeric definition ID can be obtained via crm.deal.userfield.list; method returns ID and FIELD_NAME together
facts.evidence: Official response shows ID5815 and FIELD_NAME UF_CRM_1713790573

facts.claim: Document template uses own field list and brace placeholder {UfCrm…}; copy it directly from document template list
App reads only metadata of four CRM types; exact returned key, optional upperName, search title/code/upperName, category/type filters, copy and filtered CSV
App1.0.1 is documented as installed with full acceptance open, no Market release performed
facts.status: current project documents; not independent live test
